configuration.showUsage.markdownDescript: Show Claude Code subscription usage in the Agent Mapping Claude Code group.
configuration.usageRefreshSeconds.markdo: Refresh interval in seconds for Claude Code usage. Values below 300 seconds are clamped to 300. Usage responses are shared through a 10-minute global storage cache to avoid API rate limits.
configuration.claudeMdGuidance.markdownD: On activation, upsert a managed block into the workspace CLAUDE.md that makes the `anytime-dev-cycle` skill the default for development instructions. Only the marked block is ever rewritten; user content is never touched.
config.gitActivityRetentionDays.descript: Number of days to keep git activity records in the agent-status DB. Records older than this are pruned when the worker starts.
config.workSnapshotIntervalMinutes.descr: Interval in minutes for taking a non-destructive snapshot of uncommitted work (including untracked files) into `refs/anytime/snapshots/`. Set to 0 to disable. Values between 1 and 4 are treated as 5.
config.workSnapshotRetentionDays.descrip: Number of days to keep work snapshot refs before pruning them.
configuration.tickets.directory.markdown: Location of the ticket repository used by the anytime-loop-start skill (root of a local clone, or the .tickets/ directory; absolute or workspace-relative). When unset, resolution falls back to .tickets/ at the workspace root, then the ANYTIME_TICKETS_DIR environment variable.
configuration.tickets.workspace.markdown: Workspace identifier the anytime-loop-start skill uses to scope automatic execution. Only tickets whose `workspace` matches this value are picked up. When unset, the workspace root directory name is used, so this is usually not needed. Set it explicitly where the directory name does not match (worktrees, clones under a different name).
config.tickets.github.repo: Target GitHub repository for the ticket board, in `owner/repo` form. Leave empty to infer from the workspace `origin` remote. Separate from `anytimeAgent.tickets.directory`, which points at a local clone used by the anytime-loop-start skill.
config.tickets.github.branch: Target branch for the ticket board. Leave empty to infer from the workspace current branch.
config.tickets.provider: Where tickets are read from and written to. `local-git` uses the local clone directly (write, commit, push) and needs no GitHub sign-in. `github-contents` / `github-issues` go through the GitHub API and require sign-in.
config.tickets.github.provider: Ticket store provider for the board. `github-contents` uses `.tickets/*.md` via the Contents API. `github-issues` uses GitHub Issues.
config.tickets.github.provider.deprecate: Use `anytimeAgent.tickets.provider` instead. This key is still honored when the new one is unset.
